title: The Last Bookshop
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The last independent bookshop in the city\'s old quarter is closing, and its owner, Elias March, has forty days to sell the stock he has kept for forty years. On the final day, a woman walks in and asks for a book that was never published — and Elias must decide what he has actually been keeping.
